posts.en:
dsh-atomgit is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eb354e3764661a9f89fb.html
